block.zh-CN: 将按钮设置为块级按钮。
block.en-US: Renders the button as a block-level button.

children.zh-CN: 按钮的文字内容的 snippet；没有 `children` 且有图标或处于加载状态时，按纯图标按钮处理。
children.en-US: Snippet for the button text. Without `children`, a button that shows an icon or is loading is treated as an icon-only button.

colorful.zh-CN: 多彩按钮，仅支持 primary 与 tertiary 类型。未设置时使用所在 ButtonGroup 的值，最终默认为 false。
colorful.en-US: Colorful button, supported for the primary and tertiary types only. Falls back to the ButtonGroup it is in, and finally to false.

contentClassName.en-US: Class name of the content area.

disabled.zh-CN: 禁用状态，优先于 loading。未设置时使用所在 ButtonGroup 的值，最终默认为 false。
disabled.en-US: Disabled state, which takes precedence over loading. Falls back to the ButtonGroup it is in, and finally to false.

htmlType.zh-CN: 原生 button 的 type 值，可选 button、reset 或 submit。
htmlType.en-US: Native type of the button: button, reset or submit.

icon.zh-CN: 按钮图标的 snippet，位置由 iconPosition 决定；参数为 `{ fill }`，多彩按钮给出填充色，需传给图标组件。
icon.en-US: Snippet for the button icon, placed by iconPosition. Its argument is `{ fill }`: a colorful button supplies the fill, which has to be passed to the icon component.

iconPosition.zh-CN: 图标位置，可选 left 或 right。

loading.zh-CN: 加载状态。加载中按钮保持可聚焦，点击不触发 onclick，submit 按钮也不提交表单。
loading.en-US: Loading state. A loading button stays focusable, its onclick is not called, and a submit button does not submit its form.

noHorizontalPadding.zh-CN: 去掉水平方向的内边距，可选 true、left、right 或二者的数组；只对设置了图标或处于加载状态的按钮有效。
noHorizontalPadding.en-US: Removes horizontal padding: true, left, right or an array of both. Applies only to a button that shows an icon or the loading spinner.

size.zh-CN: 按钮尺寸，可选 large、default 或 small。未设置时使用所在 ButtonGroup 的值，最终默认为 default。
size.en-US: Button size: large, default or small. Falls back to the ButtonGroup it is in, and finally to default.

theme.zh-CN: 按钮主题，可选 solid、borderless、light 或 outline。未设置时使用所在 ButtonGroup 的值，最终默认为 light。
theme.en-US: Button theme: solid, borderless, light or outline. Falls back to the ButtonGroup it is in, and finally to light.

type.zh-CN: 按钮类型，可选 primary、secondary、tertiary、warning 或 danger。未设置时使用所在 ButtonGroup 的值，最终默认为 primary。
type.en-US: Button type: primary, secondary, tertiary, warning or danger. Falls back to the ButtonGroup it is in, and finally to primary.

colorful.zh-CN: 多彩样式，作为组内按钮的默认值。
colorful.en-US: Colorful style, used as the default of the buttons in the group.

disabled.zh-CN: 禁用状态，作为组内按钮的默认值。
disabled.en-US: Disabled state, used as the default of the buttons in the group.

size.zh-CN: 按钮尺寸，作为组内按钮的默认值。
size.en-US: Button size, used as the default of the buttons in the group.

theme.zh-CN: 按钮主题，作为组内按钮的默认值。
theme.en-US: Button theme, used as the default of the buttons in the group.

type.zh-CN: 按钮类型，作为组内按钮的默认值。
type.en-US: Button type, used as the default of the buttons in the group.

children.zh-CN: 分裂按钮：一个 Button 加一个包裹 Button 的 Dropdown。
children.en-US: A Button followed by a Dropdown that wraps a Button.
